svg.title: The tuned PI on four deliberately wrong heaters
svg.desc: With three times the heater gain the loop settles after one overshoot; with eight times it swings every 4 seconds between 28.9 and 41.4 degrees Celsius. With 4 seconds more delay it rings every 22 seconds, its maxima 0.84, 0.43 and 0.17 degrees above the target; with 7 seconds more it swings without settling and is still 1.57 degrees off at 60 seconds.
svg.text: The tuned PI on four deliberately wrong heaters
Control Studio validation of this project · setpoint 35 → 38 °C at 0 s · numbers answer the predictions
+4 s: every 22 s, 0.84 → 0.43 → 0.17 °C above the target
